objective: Test whether the repeated ring of f57v supplies an ordered injective alphabet or source-stable sign equivalences that could constrain later decipherment, without assigning expected words or sounds.
prior_exposure: The ring, modern ZL/IT/GC records, historical H/V/U records and Stolfi's Note034 have been read. Counts around17, historical f/p,j/d,I/c alternatives, repeated r, and the IT terminal r-n / GC initial oe discrepancies are already known. This is a descriptive source audit, not a blind discovery or significance test.
sources: Pinned ZL3b/IT2a from phase40; original Stolfi interlinear16e6 gzip; native Yale image1006187. GC is an exact web-rendered locus excerpt because direct HTTP download returned406; no complete original GC byte hash is claimed.
units: Primary units are published delimiter-separated entries. ZL/GC use periods, IT uses<->, historical copies use dashes. Remove only the modern time comment, historical ! padding and period-boundary {|} markup. Preserve every alphabetic compound, rare-symbol annotation, capital letter and alternative. Only exact ? or * is an uninformative unknown. *{&169} and analogous historical forms are opaque annotated signs, not the unknown placeholder.
cycles: Historical {|} boundaries are explicit. Modern boundaries are the four documented recurrence starts: ZL/IT o,l; GC o,e or the last combined oe. No cycle is padded or truncated to17. No cross-alphabet conversion between EVA and v101.
reports: For every source report all units, four cycle lengths, known/unknown/alternative counts, definite duplicate units within each cycle, and all six pairwise edit distances. Edit cost1 for insertion,deletion,substitution;0 for intersecting explicit alternatives or unknown compatibility. Also record all optimal alignments' path counts. Unknown-compatible matches are not evidence of sign identity.
alphabet_test: An injective complete alphabet listing once each would require no definite duplicate unit in a cycle. Report exact duplicate witnesses. This only tests the declared transcription units, not every possible glyph distinction or composite writing model.
conditional_alias_graph: Only cycles that natively contain17 entries are admitted. Connect position nodes to every fully known singleton unit observed there; alternatives and unknowns do not contribute edges. Components show the merges that WOULD follow if corresponding positions encode the same underlying item. Report components joining distinct positions and their sign forms. Never apply inferred aliases globally to the manuscript. Errors or intentionally different items can invalidate the same-item premise.
count_sensitivity: Separately report the effects of three explicitly observed regroupings: split each ZL @169;v into @169; and v; split the GC final-cycle initial oe into o,e; join the IT final r,n as a single bundle. These are alternative encodings, not palaeographic adjudications. Keep primary outputs unchanged and do not use the regrouped versions to learn aliases.
images: Preserve native page and an exploratory nearest-neighbour polar strip centred at(1740,1460),radii1060..821,start-144degrees,width6100. Four90degree quarters are display regions, not fitted cycle boundaries. No glyph is retouched. This geometrical display cannot validate linguistic units or an alphabet.
software_checks: Verify exact/alternative/unknown token distinctions, small known edit distances and optimal path counts, raw extraction and reconstruction, duplicate witnesses and graph connectivity by a separate algorithm. Repeat all outputs byte-for-byte from frozen inputs.
conclusions: No phonetic values, language, numeric meaning or translation may be inferred from repetition alone. Record source-dependent contradictions and preserve the unidentifiability of output-letter values under arbitrary relabelling.
next_decision: If the ring fails to supply source-stable distinct units and independent values, do not turn it into an alphabet key. An external candidate remains the explicitly numbered marginal sequence of f49v; its numeral interpretation, dating and counting relationship would require a separate falsifiable test.
delivery: Local research dossier, source provenance, native image, code and report. No publication, push or external message. The original decipherment goal remains unachieved unless verified continuous plaintext is obtained.
